description: This Java source file defines a DialogFragment class for selecting and editing categories within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages UI components, data binding, and interactions for category selection, including observing category data and handling user input.

classes.name: CategoryDialogFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment for selecting and editing categories, with data binding, category list observation, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the dialog UI components based on the provided color.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment, retrieves the account ID argument, and sets up the listener interface.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel for category data.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the dialog UI, sets up data binding, category list observation, and user interaction handlers.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current category text state.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Shows the keyboard if the category input is empty.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes observers from LiveData to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the fragment with specified account ID and category.
